excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**rezanmmd1**
Hi Guys, the exact time for eth2 running is still on 1 Dec?

excerpts.author: _0xuser
excerpts.content:
It depends on how much Ether is deposited into the deposit contract.

If it reaches the minimum number of validators by November 24th, then yes, the beacon chain will go live on December 1st. If not, it will be 7 days after the minimum number of validators is reached.

excerpts.author: _0xuser
excerpts.content:
<@708038436031955016> Do you mean POW? Yes, we will likely have POW for at least one more year.

The merge between Eth1 and Eth2 is under research, but won't happen until the beacon chain works fine for some time. It needs to prove that it's safe enough to be the only consensus layer of Mainnet.
